liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Called a new beginning after a rough opening; one of the reviewer's favorite versions, with Jerry stretching out despite limits on Bob songs [25]
- **Friend Of The Devil** (1 review): Reviewer found the Friend tight [25]

## Setlist highlights

- **New Year countdown**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 3 archived performances [27]
- **tech problem**: rare: 3 archived performances [27]

## The recordings

- **gd1977-12-31.141799.sbd.gurman.bershaw.sirmick.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 181 min [1]. Said about its sound: Described as a sbd/ambient blend mixed to mono, with masters labelled 'Remote', possibly a feed mix [1]
- **gd1977-12-31.151333.sbd.bear.gems.V3.flac2496**: soundboard; 20 songs; 175 min [4]
- **gd1977-12-31.151251.sbd.bear.gems.flac2496**: soundboard; 20 songs; 175 min [6]
- **gd77-12-31.sbd.purvis.286.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 161 min; rated 3.86/5 by 37 [9]. Said about its sound: Reviewer rates the sound a 4 out of 5; playing is tight and rocking but nothing special [24]

## Around the show

- Door staff handed out a flyer saying midnight would happen around 12:30, since Bill rang in the new year at the Cow Palace with Santana first [15]
- New Riders Of The Purple Sage opened the show [4]
- New Riders Of The Purple Sage opened the show [6]
- Reviewer says the show rocks consistently throughout, with no spacey jams, and Jerry was as loud as they ever heard him [15]
- Reviewer likens this Jack Straw to the 11/6/77 version [25]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1977-12-31.141799.sbd.gurman.bershaw.sirmick.flac1644**: taped by Bob Gurman and Alan Berdhaw; transferred by SIRMick; source: Source: SBD > Umatic videotape masters (noted as "remote") - From Bob Gurman; [1]. Also: Masters transferred direct to untracked CDs in 2002; speed checked correct at A=440 [1]
- **gd1977-12-31.151333.sbd.bear.gems.V3.flac2496**: taped by Bear; transferred by Transferred and Mastered by Jim Blackwood Speed Correction by Jason Chastain Patched where needed (mostly between song tunings) using shnid=141799 + 20596; source: Bear's Master Reel > Cassette (Music Never Stopped through Truckin') + Bear's Master Cassette (Wharf Rat through Casey Jones). [4]. Also: Version three, made January 1, 2021, fixed a channel reversal in the original seed and flipped Keith's channel placement [4]
- **gd1977-12-31.151251.sbd.bear.gems.flac2496**: taped by Bear; transferred by Transferred and Mastered by Jim Blackwood Speed Correction by Jason Chastain; source: Bear's Master Reel > Cassette (Music Never Stopped through Truckin') + Bear's Master Cassette (Wharf Rat through Casey Jones). [6]. Also: Comes from about 45 of Bear's tapes passed on by a close friend who visited Australia; aired on KXCI Tucson December 27, 2020 [6]
- **gd77-12-31.sbd.purvis.286.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [9]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead - 1977-12-31 Winterland Arena, San Francisco, CA](https://thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com/2018/06/grateful-dead-1977-12-31-winterland.html) [28]
- Poster by thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead - 1977-12-31 Winterland Arena, San Francisco, CA](https://thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com/2018/06/grateful-dead-1977-12-31-winterland.html) [31]
